tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa glang dmar chen gtor bzlog mdzad skabs kyi phyag len ji ltar bya tshul sngags 'chang mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor las/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i man ngag g.yul rgyal gyi dgongs pa/ dpal sa skyar mdzad pa'i dmar chen gtor bzlog 'di la 'don pa dbyangs rol sogs mi 'dra ba du mas the tshom yod 'dug pas/ slan chad 'di sor bzhag byed rgyur/ zor las pa gcig gam lnga gang bde yin/ bsnyen pa kha gso sogs nged rang gi brtsams pa'i dus mdos zor las pa nyer mkho'i yi ge bzhin la/ bstod pa'i skabs bzlas pa dang dril gsil mi dgos/ tshul nyin nyi rtse dang bstun/ 'phags pa dang / mkhas btsun pa grags blo ba'i thugs dam 'chams sku lnga/ spyan 'dren dus mdos rgyal tho sgang du byed pa sor bzhag la las mkhas dang 'thon rim rnams lde phyung bar tho zur yod/ gzhi thog tshoms chen du tshugs na/ byon skyems gsum brdeg len can mjug gi rol bskor chig brdung dang bstun rnga rol rnams tshoms chen 'gag gi skras byang brgyud gzhol gyi shag steng sgrigs pa dus mdos bzhin/ lha chen phun tshogs gling lta bur tshugs pa yin na/ rol bskor chig brdung gi mdun nas/ jo mo thar ra bar der gser skyems gtor la rol mo bzhi brdung du bsgyur/ sku 'chams ci rigs mdzad nas rim gyis bde yangs su rnga rol nub nas shar ltar lho gzigs su sgrigs/ 'chams sku'i 'chams ci rigs grub pa dang / 'dus nas gnas khang gang yin 'dir 'tshog rgyu yin pas/ gang ltar chos dung byung ba dang bstun tshogs la sngon 'gro gtor ma drug cu pa bzhin/ gnas yo byin brlab kyai rdor bzhin dkar chab bdag bskyed lam dus/ kyai rdor maṇḍal sgrub mchod gtor bsngo rgyun bzhin nyer gsum nas tshugs pa yin na/ gsum bzhi lnga rnams la bzlas pa drug cu sor bzhag la bran bdud med pa/

phur srung sngags kyi rjes su bha ya na gsum/ dmod pa thal brdeb rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral bar/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ phrin bcol bshags pa gsum/ gsol ba/ dgangs dung byung ba dang bstun nas bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ bskang ba thugs dam ma mgo dbyangs sor bzhag la/ gtum chen ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma/ bshags bzlog rnams bdun re/ dpang gzugs drag bskul mi dgos/ bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan srung ma rgyas pa/ rdor glu nas deng 'dir stsol bar rgyun bskang bzhin mjug chog mdos chen bzhin/ nyer drug nas tshugs pa yin na/ sngon gtor nas gzhi bdag gtor bsngo'i bar gong bzhin la yig brgya bdun/ de wa pi tsu nyer gcig gur mgon yi ge bdun ma nas/ zhal gyi bar 'phreng 'khor re/ gri ha rā dza bdun/ ro ru dang a li gnyis lnga bcu re/ dkar bdud phur srung gi sngags gnyis bdun re/ 'di thams cad shib bu yin/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ phrin bcol bshags pa gsum/ bskang ba dgu lugs dbyangs tshes thogs gzhung bsrang / spyan 'dren la bzhugs nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol gyi rjes su/ bskang gsar spyan 'dren dbyangs/ gang gi rang bzhin dang / byang shar ha ha gnyis shur ma/ dur khrod bdag po'i mthar chems brdung / byon skyems 'bul sngags sogs rgyun bzhin/ nag po mchod rten gyi rjes su bstan srung rgya mtsho nas sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlobs bar/ lha mo'i sgos bskang rdzogs nas/ gsol ba/ pu tra'i sgos bskang dang rjes 'brel mgo dbyangs sngon 'gro'i nag po gnod sbyin ma gsum/ dkar chen la dam tshig chen po dang / ma bhyo ma'i dbyangs med pa/ nag po mi zad kyi mthar chems brdung mi dgos/ mgo dbyangs sngon 'gro'i dkar chung gcig gtum chen ma dang / sku dang gsung thugs ma dbyangs rol bcas gsum re/ nag po mchod rten gyi phrin bcol rdzogs nas bskang gsar phrin las bcol/

bskang gsar bzlog pa/ do nub bzlog bsgyur la drug pa la rol mo/ bka' bsgo'i rjes su dpang gzugs/ bse mgon drag bskul/ dus gsum rgyal ba/ zhal pu tra rnams kyi drag bskul/ bstod pa nyer drug dus gtor bzhin/ gzhan gong bzhin/ zhes gsungs pas bshags bzlog spel ma bdun re gsog dgos/ nyer bdun la sngon gtor nas bshags pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ phyag 'tshal sngon 'gro'i bshags pa gsum/ khyed thugs ma gdangs ring / bskang rdzas byin brlabs nas/ dur khrod bdag po sogs kyi spyan 'dren bar nyer bdun bzhin la chems brdung / dkar mo'i spyan 'dren mi dgos/ byon skyems chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ 'bul sngags sogs rgyun bzhin/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ rdo rje brag chen nas kyai bos so ma rdzogs pa'i bar nyer bdun dus gtor bzhin/ nag po mchod rten rdzogs nas gsol ba/ lha mo'i spyan 'dren yongs rdzogs/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma zhes sogs/ lha mo'i sgos bskang la gzhan yang ma ring mo sbyar ba/ zhal gyi spyan 'dren yongs rdzogs/ lha mchog ma dbyangs ring gang yin rakta dam rdzas gdong bzhi rnams la dbyangs/ dmag zor dur bdag dad pa dang ni sogs pu tra'i sgos bskang nyer drug bzhin/ rnam dag tshogs gtor ma dbyangs res gang yin bdud dpung kun 'joms ma/ che zhes che mo sogs dkar mo'i sgos bskang / dam tshig chen po dang ma bhyo ma dbyangs/ dkar chung nas nag po mchod rten 'phrin bcol rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ bzlog pa bshags pa bka' bsgo/ de'i gras dpal ldan mgon po la dgu brdung len dgos gang yod rdzogs mthar dpang gzugs drag bskul rnga shon/ bstod pa nyer bdun bzhin no/ /nyer brgyad la sngon gtor nas bshags pa rdzogs pa'i bar nyer bdun bzhin/ bskang ba chos nyid ma'i bcom rol la chems brdung rjes ma rdzogs nas gnyis brdeg len med/

dad pa dang ni srin thung / ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol la tshig rol/ chos nyid ma'i spyan 'dren/ byon skyems 'bul sngags bcas rgyun bzhin/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ rdo rje brag chen nas kye bos ma rdzogs pa'i bar shur ma/ chos nyid ma'i bskang ba rdzogs nas gsol ba/ chos dbyings spros bral sogs lha mo'i sgos bskang la gzhan yang ma shur ma/ zhal la nyer brgyad dus gtor sogs bzhag la lha mchog ma dbyangs res gang yin/ dmag zor ma dur khrod bdag po dang pu tra dang dkar mo ba nyer bdun bzhin la/ nag po gnod sbyin ma dang / dkar chung dbyangs med pa/ gtum chen ma dang sku dang gsung thugs ma dbyangs rol med pa/ bse khrab pa rdzogs pa de bar gong bzhin/ bshags pa mi dgos/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma/ nag po mchod rten 'phrin bcol dgu brdung gcig bzlog pa thugs dam shur ma bzhin/ bshags pa dang bka' bsgo dbyangs med pa/ chos nyid ma'i 'phrin bcol bzlog pa/ dpang gzugs drag bskul/ chos nyid ma bshags pa bstod pa nyer brgyad bzhin no/ /nyer dgu la sngon gtor nas khyed thugs ma'i bar gong bzhin khyed thugs ma gdangs thung / bskang ba bstod pa bcas nyer dgu'i dus gtor sor bzhag la/ rkyen ngan rbod gtong med par mdzod kyi mthar dgu brdung gcig nag po mchod rten bzlog pa shur ma gcig dpang gzugs drag bskul mi dgos/ phur srung bstod pa'i mthar gsum brdeg len can/ rdor glu bkra shis smon lam rdzogs nas mjug chog bkra shis 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sogs mdzad dus mdos sngon 'gro'i sku rim yin na/ rol phod dang gos bor dgos pas/ rnga pa byings rang rang lcam tse dang / gnas skabs gzhan lcam tse phod kha mi dgos/ phyir rnga rol gral bsgrigs grub pa dang bcom dung bcom rol 'phar ma gsum brdeg len can lugs/ shā sa na'i sngags dbyangs gnyis brdeg len med 'phar ma ja mchod/ rnam kun mchog ldan skabs bdud rtsi ril bu bskyed/

mgon po'i bka' nyan ging chen gdug pa 'dul la bstod gyi bar dus mdos bzhin la dbyangs res med pa/ 'jigs byed dbyings las/ sngon tshe gsang sngags/ bsad pa'i sha dang rnams shlau ka re 'dur ma'i mthar/ gsum brdeg len can 'chams thon tshul lde phung par tho zur yod/ de nas rol skor chig brdung gi phyir byon la/ ji ltar rigs par bzhi 'gros su bsgyur ba nas bcom len bcu bzhi brdeg gnyis brdeg rol skor 'bebs bcas bar dus mdos bzhin la rnga gros mi dgos/ gung gseng / ja mchod bskal bzang ma/ bcom dung bcom rol gnyis brdeg 'phar ma/ nam mkha' 'brug sgra/ sgar dbyangs lcam dral khyed kyi nas shur ma sogs/ pu tra'i drag bskul rdzogs pa'i bar drug cu pa bzhin/ bzhi 'gros kyis ci rigs su 'chams dang gsum brdeg len can/ dus gsum rgyal ba drug cu pa bzhin yang ci rigs su bzhi 'gros gong bzhin rdzogs pa sum brdeg len can/ gser skyems dpang gzugs zor lam dbye ba pho nya bskul rnams drug cu pa bzhin la/ mi nag gi gnyis brdeg len can rdzogs pa dang 'then rkang gsum chems brdung gi gtor ma 'phang / sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes rnga rol bzhag nas log ci rigs su 'chams/ sku'i zoms 'gres grub pa dang / ja mchod phun tshogs gtsug nor srid zhi dpal 'byor mas bcom dung bzung / sgrub khang gi mdor 'chams sku'i sku 'chams rdzogs pa'i bar dus mdos bzhin/ gnam gang la dkar chag phur chung gtor bsngo nas bzung gnas mchog 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir stsol bar/ gnam gang dus gtor sor bzhag la 'chams sku mgon khang so sor phebs tshul rgyal zla'i tshes gcig bzhin no// //zhes pa 'di yang sa glang lor dmar chen gtor bzlog bgyis skabs sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sa glang dmar chen gtor bzlog mdzad skabs kyi phyag len/
